'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Six [[Pakistan Army|soldiers]] are killed and 17 [[civilian]]s are injured during a series of nine attacks in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pakistan-troops-search-attackers-after-6-soldiers-killed-95819473 (ABC News)]
*[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
**Fourteen Iranian fishermen are returned to [[Iran]] after eight years of captivity in [[Somalia]]. The men were found in Somalia by police last month and freed from [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[jihadist]]s after negotiations between the captors, [[tribal chief]]s and Somali elders. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/12/25/Fisherman-return-to-Iran-years-after-Somalia-kidnapping (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Northern Mindanao floods]]
**At least eight people are killed, and 19 others are missing from [[monsoon]] floods in the [[Visayas]] and [[Mindanao]] regions of the [[Philippines]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-12-27/philippines-reports-eight-deaths-as-floods-disrupt-christmas/101809826 (Reuters via ABC News)]
*At least four people are injured, one of them seriously, when an [[avalanche]] hits the [[ski resort]] [[Zürs]]/[[Lech am Arlberg|Lech]] in [[Vorarlberg]], [[Austria]]. [[Emergency services]] rescue all of the ten people who had been buried alive. [https://www.rtl.de/cms/lawine-am-arlberg-oesterreich-alle-vermissten-wintersportler-gerettet-vier-verletzte-5022519.html?utm_term=rtl-aktuell&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=echobox&utm_source=Facebook#Echobox=1672040441 (RTL News in ''German'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Catalonia]] in [[Spain]] registers the highest December temperature ever for the [[autonomous community]] in [[Anglès, Girona|Anglès]], which reached {{cvt|26.3|C|F}}. Several other stations, including in the regional capital of [[Barcelona]], also break records. [https://www.catalannews.com/society-science/item/catalonias-not-so-white-christmas-day-after-recording-warmest-temperatures-in-decades (Catalan News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Pierce County substation attack]]
**An attack on an [[electrical substation]] in [[Pierce County, Washington|Pierce County]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]], [[power outage|cuts off power]] to 14,000 people. The perpetrators and motive of the attack are unknown. [https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/tacoma-power-says-2-substations-attacked-christmas-day/ (''Seattle Times'')]
*A court in the [[Maldives]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] former [[President of the Maldives|president]] [[Abdulla Yameen]] to 11 years in prison on [[money laundering]] and [[bribery]] charges. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/maldives-leader-gets-11-years-money-laundering-bribe-95808032 (ABC News)]
